Subject: Medicore private-offer: MAP, acceptance gates, billing handoff

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) to align on acceptance criteria, procurement milestones, and the billing handoff for the AWS private-offer flow.

High level ask: can your procurement team confirm the following by EOD next Tuesday (2026-09-08)?
- 1) Acceptance gate owners (technical, legal, procurement)
- 2) PO target issue date and preferred billing cadence (monthly/quarterly)
- 3) Any required amendment language for the AWS private-offer

What's attached: Medicore_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), PO-draft-Medicore.pdf (our standard PO template with placeholder SOW), aws-private-offer-terms-2026.docx (AWS marketplace terms reference).

I've looped in Marissa and Karthik for billing & legal clarifications and Grace for rollout scheduling. Suggested timeline in the sheet assumes a 3-week evaluation window followed by a staged acceptance: 1) API smoke tests (redwood-hosted), 2) Production acceptance on 10k tokens/day sample, 3) Billing activation and invoice handoff to your finance team.

If any of the milestones look off from your side, flag them inline in the MAP and I'll iterate.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Sergio — thanks for the rapid follow-up and the clear MAP. We're aligned on the approach but have a couple of asks from procurement before we can commit to dates: 

1) Our finance team needs the final invoice flow and whether Redwood will issue a single consolidated invoice or re-route via AWS Marketplace invoicing. Please clarify both scenarios.
2) We require confirmation that data residency for the evaluation (test dataset) will remain in us-west-2.
3) Legal asked for a short redline on the private-offer amendment; we can provide comments by 9/6 if you can get an updated terms doc by 9/4.

I'll assign our procurement lead (procurement@medicore.ai) to the MAP. Tentatively we prefer monthly billing, but I will confirm after finance reviews the AWS marketplace routing.

Best,
Elena Novak
Head of Product, Medicore

Elena / team — quick confirmation on billing options and the operational path: 

Option A (Marketplace invoicing):
- Timeline: requires Marketplace Billing Agreement + AWS acceptance; estimated 10 business days from signed MAA.
- Handoff: AWS invoices Medicore directly; Redwood receives settlement from AWS.
- Pros/Cons: simpler for your AP team but delays go-live for invoicing.

Option B (Direct Redwood invoicing):
- Timeline: 3 business days after PO receipt to issue first invoice.
- Handoff: Redwood invoices Medicore; standard net-30 payment terms (can be tailored).
- Pros/Cons: fastest billing activation; requires a direct PO route in your procurement system.

For the MAP schedule: assuming we get procurement sign-off (PO issued) by 9/15, proposed milestones are:
- 9/16–9/22: Staged evaluation (smoke tests + perf run)
- 9/23: Production acceptance gate
- 9/24–9/27: Billing activation + first invoice (if direct invoicing)

Please indicate preference and whether your finance wants us to prepare the Marketplace Billing Agreement to accelerate Option A.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@medicore.ai>

Thanks everyone — short answers after internal sync: 
- Procurement prefers Option B (direct Redwood invoicing) to avoid the Marketplace lead time. We'll issue PO by 9/15.
- Finance confirms monthly billing cadence and wants invoices sent to ap@medicore.ai.
- Legal will provide redlines to the aws-private-offer-terms doc by 9/06 (Karthik, I saw your note and that timeline works).
- Data residency: confirmed — evaluation data will stay in us-west-2.

We'll update the MAP sheet with the PO target and invoice recipient. Once PO is issued, can Redwood confirm 3 business-day invoice issuance and the 72-hour activation SLA mentioned by Karthik?

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Elena Novak
Head of Product, Medicore
